change_records: parse: 嗅探并规范化材料，最小去重喂流量计数
criteria: 资格标准来自 task.md，由模型编译并经人工确认登记
prescreen: 机器可判标准由脚本预判并落账
judgments: 模型批量判定，引用经逐珠子串校验
ledger/flow/report: 计数全部由账本行重算

candidate_set.evidence_quote: double-blind randomized controlled trial in 124 adults (aged 18-65) with chronic insomnia
candidate_set.rationale: 双盲 RCT，成人慢性失眠，NX-3 对比安慰剂，主结局为入睡潜伏期：四条纳入标准全部满足。
candidate_set.title: Synthetic peptide NX-3 versus placebo for sleep latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial

candidate_set.evidence_quote: randomly assigned 240 adults with chronic insomnia to NX-3 or matching placebo
candidate_set.rationale: 多中心 RCT，成人慢性失眠，NX-3 对比匹配安慰剂，主结局 sleep onset latency。
candidate_set.title: NX-3 versus placebo on sleep onset latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a multicenter randomized controlled trial

candidate_set.evidence_quote: 110 adults with chronic insomnia took NX-3 or placebo at bedtime
candidate_set.rationale: 睡前给药 RCT，成人慢性失眠，NX-3 对比安慰剂，主结局 sleep latency。
candidate_set.title: Bedtime administration of NX-3 versus placebo and sleep latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial

candidate_set.evidence_quote: randomized controlled trial, 96 older adults (aged 60-80) with chronic insomnia received NX-3 or placebo
candidate_set.rationale: 老年成人 RCT，NX-3 对比安慰剂，结局含 sleep latency。
candidate_set.title: Effects of NX-3 versus placebo on sleep latency in older adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial

candidate_set.evidence_quote: randomized controlled trial of NX-3 versus placebo
candidate_set.rationale: 成人慢性失眠且基线睡眠潜伏期 >30 分钟，NX-3 对比安慰剂 RCT，主终点 sleep latency。
candidate_set.title: NX-3 versus placebo in adults with chronic insomnia and prolonged sleep latency: a randomized controlled trial.

candidate_set.evidence_quote: Sleep onset latency was recorded as an exploratory secondary outcome
candidate_set.rationale: I4 要求结局指标“包含”入睡潜伏期，未限定必须为主要结局；该研究以活动记录仪测量了 sleep onset latency，判纳入。
candidate_set.title: NX-3 versus placebo and sleep quality in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial

prisma_flow.counting_rule: 每个计数均为对 decision_ledger.jsonl 行的实际计数（identified/duplicates 来自 dedup_summary.json 的实际去重组数），无任何断言式数字。

screening_criteria.definition: 研究设计为随机对照试验（RCT）；准随机/交替分配不满足。
screening_criteria.source_quote: 研究设计必须为**随机对照试验（RCT）**

screening_criteria.definition: 研究对象为 ≥18 岁成人且诊断为慢性失眠。
screening_criteria.source_quote: 研究对象必须为 **≥18 岁成人**且诊断为**慢性失眠**

screening_criteria.definition: 干预对比为 NX-3 对比安慰剂；仅活性对照而无安慰剂组者不满足。
screening_criteria.source_quote: 干预对比必须为 **NX-3 对比安慰剂**

screening_criteria.definition: 结局指标包含入睡潜伏期（sleep latency / sleep onset latency）。
screening_criteria.source_quote: 结局指标必须包含**入睡潜伏期（sleep latency / sleep onset latency）**
发表年份须在 **2015–2025** 之间，超出者排除。

screening_criteria.definition: 文献类型为综述、社论或会议摘要。
screening_criteria.source_quote: 文献类型为综述（review）、社论（editorial）或会议摘要者排除。

research_question: 合成肽 NX-3 对比安慰剂治疗成人慢性失眠的入睡潜伏期（sleep latency）疗效 —— 仅纳入随机对照试验（RCT），发表年份 2015-2025，研究对象为 ≥18 岁成人。
